::: {#exr-bear-think-shirt}
Argue that a budget constraint is another way to imply a shadow price. That helps in identifying whether off-budget items are worthwhile. 

Heuristics, e.g. budget constraint. Many people simplify their choices by setting a budget over several different categories and paying extra attention/skepticism when a proposal is made to exceed a budget. Unexpected gains (e.g. tax refunds) are outside of the budget system and can be spent on wish-list items. Unexpected costs: have a contingency fund. The credit trap. Example: Buying a house. How much down payment do we have? What's our budget for housing?

:::
